description: Quote an order (one or more products, 1-10 vials each) and get the checkout link the buyer opens to pay. Nothing is charged or reserved until the buyer pays on that page.

country.description: Country of the BUYER: US (United States, prices in USD). It is the only market served.

size.description: vial size from list_products (sizes[].size), e.g. 20mg. Optional: defaults to the first size. One size per product per link.

name: create_checkout_link
title: Create checkout link
